item.madscience.circuit_comparator.toolt: Enables electronic devices to compare items to other items.
item.madscience.circuit_diamond.tooltip: Advanced circuit used as central core in several machines.
item.madscience.circuit_emerald.tooltip: Advanced circuit that is used in the creation of some of the most scientifically accurate equipment known to Minecraft.
item.madscience.circuit_ender_eye.toolti: Advanced circuit that controls sorting data inside of machines. Using the same technology that guides you to Strongholds, this circuit can move huge data-sets around and know exactly where they should go.
item.madscience.circuit_ender_pearl.tool: Very powerful monitoring circuit that can hold data in a seemingly infinite buffer thanks to the magic of Enderman teleportation technology.
item.madscience.circuit_redstone.tooltip: Creates a multi-purpose circuit that accepts digital data as input, processes it according to instructions stored in its memory, and provides results as output.
item.madscience.circuit_spider_eye.toolt: Sensitive circuit that is used in monitoring and analysis of items not directly visible to the naked eye.
item.madscience.component_case.tooltip: A computer case, also known as a "computer chassis", "tower" or simply "case", is the enclosure that contains most of the components of a computer.
item.madscience.component_computer.toolt: A computer is a general purpose device that can be programmed to carry out a set of arithmetic or logical operations.
item.madscience.component_cpu.tooltip: A central processing unit (CPU) is the hardware within a computer that carries out the instructions of a computer program by performing the basic arithmetical, logical, and input/output operations of the system.
item.madscience.component_enderslime.too: Used in the creation of a Thumper which then goes into your Soniclocator.
item.madscience.component_fan.tooltip: A computer fan is any fan inside, or attached to, a computer case used for active cooling.
item.madscience.component_fused_quartz.t: Fused quartz is glass consisting of silica in amorphous (non-crystalline) form. Its optical and thermal properties are superior to those of other types of glass due to its purity.
Magnetic tape data storage uses digital recording on magnetic tape to store digital information. Modern magnetic tape is most commonly packaged in data reels.
item.madscience.component_power_supply.t: Provides consistent and clean power to machines and computer equipment.
item.madscience.component_ram.tooltip: Random-access memory (RAM) is a form of computer data storage. A random-access device allows stored data to be accessed directly in any random order.
item.madscience.component_screen.tooltip: A monitor or a display is an electronic visual display for computers.
A wafer is a thin slice of semiconductor material, such as a silicon crystal, used in the fabrication of integrated circuits and other microdevices.
item.madscience.component_thumper.toolti: Used in the recipe for the Soniclocator. The Soniclocator builds up energy in the goop inside these thumpers, which was collected from the Enderslime mob.
item.madscience.component_transistor.too: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify and switch electronic signals and electrical power.
item.madscience.data_reel_empty.tooltip: Magnetic tape data storage. This reel is empty and may have any sort of data imprinted onto it.
